evidence_chain: Exact GitHub Actions plan/apply operator head read through GitHub API; exact deployment.json fetched at that SHA and matches local immutable Git blob.
Private workflow checks out operator at github.sha. configure.py --from-aws preserves worker_resources from that exact deployment.json; it only resolves integration metadata and role history.

Private workflow places worker_resources in deployment.auto.tfvars.json and verify_plan_metadata compares plan variables to the same configuration. Saved successful plan review includes integration_metadata_verified; apply used the reviewed plan hashes.

Public aws_ecs_task_definition.tasks uses worker_resources[stage].memory. Container has no lower memory cap; normal state-machine ContainerOverrides contain only command. No sizing mutation in this worker branch.
kind: Azure service-tag replay memory margin against applied configured collector task limit
limitations: This proves configured/applied-source sizing and local replay process margin, not an independent live ECS DescribeTaskDefinition read.
RSS is measured on macOS for one saved full-native response set, including imports and retained recording data. It is not a Linux cgroup-wide measurement or an all-estates capacity guarantee.
Prior and repeated candidate RSS varied. The second pair did not reproduce incremental growth, but stable memory improvement is not established.
Root owns any release and post-release ECS/whole-job validation, including content-scanner child processes. No new cloud resource or production scan was created for this evidence.
